method.order: physical structures first, cross-view identity second, current-M1 sign mapping last
method.segmentation: strict = only structures with a defensible visual boundary; liberal = also sub-structures, faint smears and speckle fields

method.m1Mapping: a structure maps only on a STRONG resemblance to one of the ten current M1 sign classes; pareidolia-dependent readings are recorded as ambiguous
method.v3Vocabulary: bands rim_upper/middle/lower_base/uncertain; form and relation words follow the current V3 contract

v3g1.note: V3G1 physical fields (topology, bandCoverage, markKind, clearAreas) were added ONLY where the annotation text above already records the physical fact; no image was fetched or re-read. Ambiguous wording (HALIL P5 'curved base pool / crescent band', UNAL P3 drip span, BASAK P1 web topology) stays unknown.

decision.rationale: every accepted cup holds at least 3 strictly bounded physical structures (median 3 strict, 6 liberal) across several bands with real relations, and cross-view identity is confirmable in 4 of 5 sets; but zero structures carry a strong resemblance to the ten current M1 sign classes, so current M1 produces no developments for any set. The recurring material is structural (trails, continuations, pools, clear areas, arcs, speckles), which points to a curated structure-first semantic lane rather than more object symbols.
caveats: segmentation is subjective: liberal counts are about twice strict counts
collage panels with perspective (and possible mirroring) make V3 handle-angle validation unreliable; V3 would keep such merges as possible_same_mark
five sets is a small corpus; the outcome is a direction, not a statistic
